heading: ## Mutation-sweep recipe — numbered steps; bounded cold-read evidence

findings.quote: Re-run step 2's checks (line count and repo revision included; neither model note records an after-revision):
findings.skill_statement: Step 9 says to re-run step 2's checks with the line count included, but step 2 at C* records only path, full sha256, mtime, repo revision and an empty `git status --porcelain -- <path>`: no line count, and no size either, so neither field has a before-baseline to re-run. Step 2's own cited pins do record both fields (mutation-case-kimi-census.md:13-16 '896 lines, 43273 B'; mutation-case-kagi-census.md:13-17 '44212 B, 886 newlines'), so the record list at C* also under-installs what its receipts pin.
